meta.scalability_note: 2 Dutch regions (Amsterdam AMS1, AMS2), OpenStack auto-scaling via Heat, no serverless or managed container auto-scaling
meta.performance_note: ISO 27001 certified, 99.9% SLA, Dutch data centers, NEN 7510 compliance, GDPR-compliant infrastructure

AWS Amplify.note: No managed front-end hosting or mobile backend service available on Cyso Cloud

AWS Lambda.note: No FaaS or serverless function platform available; Cyso Cloud is IaaS-focused with no event-driven compute offering

Amazon ECS.note: No managed container runtime without Kubernetes; workloads require self-managed Docker on Nova instances

Amazon EKS.note: Kubernetes available via OpenStack Magnum but limited lifecycle management, upgrade automation, and node-pool scaling compared to EKS

Amazon EC2.note: Broad VM flavours, SSD-backed storage, hourly billing, self-service provisioning via OpenStack Nova

AWS Batch.note: No managed batch compute service; batch workloads must be orchestrated manually on VMs

AWS Elastic Beanstalk.note: No PaaS application deployment platform; no equivalent managed runtime environment

Amazon S3.note: S3-compatible API, multi-AZ within region, supports standard bucket operations, ACLs, and pre-signed URLs

Amazon S3 Glacier.note: No cold or archival storage tier; all object storage is standard access with no tiering or lifecycle archival

Amazon EBS.note: NVMe/SSD-backed persistent block volumes, detachable from instances, snapshot support via Cinder

AWS Backup.note: Volume and instance snapshots are available but there is no centralised cross-service backup management or policy scheduling

Amazon EFS.note: No managed shared file system service; NFS must be self-hosted on instances

Amazon RDS.note: Managed MySQL and PostgreSQL available as Trove-based DBaaS; less automated than RDS with limited failover and scaling options

Amazon DocumentDB.note: No managed MongoDB-compatible document database service

Amazon DynamoDB.note: No serverless NoSQL key-value or document store service

Amazon Aurora.note: No high-availability distributed relational database engine equivalent

Amazon ElastiCache.note: No managed in-memory caching service (Redis or Memcached); must be self-hosted

Amazon Redshift.note: No managed data warehouse or columnar analytics service

AWS Application Load Balancer.note: HTTP/HTTPS load balancing via OpenStack Octavia with basic routing rules; lacks advanced content-based routing and WAF integration

AWS Network Load Balancer.equivalent: Cyso Cloud Load Balancer (OpenStack Octavia — TCP mode)
AWS Network Load Balancer.note: TCP-mode load balancing available via the same Octavia service; no dedicated ultra-low-latency NLB tier

Amazon VPC.note: Private networks, security groups, floating IPs, and router support via OpenStack Neutron

Amazon Route 53.note: Managed DNS with basic record management via OpenStack Designate; no health checks or latency-based routing

Amazon API Gateway.note: No managed API gateway service; API management must be self-hosted (e.g., Kong, NGINX)

Amazon CloudFront.note: No CDN service; content delivery requires third-party CDN or self-managed edge caching

AWS Direct Connect.note: No dedicated private connectivity service from on-premise to Cyso Cloud data centers

Amazon Rekognition.note: No managed image or video analysis service

Amazon SageMaker.note: No managed machine learning platform for training, experimentation, or model deployment

Amazon Bedrock.note: No managed generative AI or foundation model API service

AWS Glue.note: No managed ETL or data integration service

Amazon EMR.note: No managed big data processing service (Hadoop/Spark); must be self-hosted on VMs

Amazon Athena.note: No serverless SQL analytics service over object storage

AWS IAM.note: Project/domain RBAC, token-based API authentication, user and group management via OpenStack Keystone

Amazon Cognito.note: No managed identity provider or customer identity and access management (CIAM) service

AWS IAM Identity Center.note: No single sign-on or centralised identity federation across multiple accounts

AWS KMS.note: Key lifecycle management via OpenStack Barbican; no dedicated HSM backing or customer-managed key policies

AWS Secrets Manager.note: No managed secrets storage or automated secret rotation service

AWS Certificate Manager.note: No managed TLS certificate provisioning or renewal service

Amazon GuardDuty.note: No managed threat detection or continuous security monitoring service

AWS Security Hub.note: No centralised security posture management or compliance dashboard

AWS Config.note: No managed resource configuration compliance or change tracking service

AWS Shield.note: Data centre DDoS mitigation is included at the network layer; no application-layer DDoS protection or managed WAF integration

AWS WAF.note: No managed web application firewall service

AWS CloudTrail.note: Basic API audit logging available via OpenStack audit middleware; limited log retention, querying, and integration with SIEM tooling

Amazon CloudWatch.note: Resource metrics collection and threshold alerts via OpenStack Gnocchi/Aodh; less integrated and feature-rich than CloudWatch

Amazon SNS.note: No managed pub/sub notification service; alerting is limited to email thresholds in the monitoring stack

AWS Systems Manager.note: No managed infrastructure operations or patch management service

AWS Cost Explorer.note: Per-project usage and cost reporting is available directly in the Cyso Cloud portal with resource-level breakdown

AWS CodeBuild.note: No managed CI build service; CI must be hosted externally (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins on VMs)

AWS CodePipeline.note: No managed CI/CD pipeline orchestration service

Amazon ECR.note: Basic Docker container registry available; limited vulnerability scanning and no deep integration with Kubernetes lifecycle

AWS CloudFormation.note: No native IaC orchestration service; Terraform OpenStack provider is available as the recommended infrastructure-as-code path

AWS IoT Core.note: No managed IoT messaging or device connectivity service

AWS IoT Device Management.note: No managed IoT device registry, OTA update, or fleet management service

Amazon SQS.note: No managed message queuing service; must be self-hosted (e.g., RabbitMQ on VMs)

Amazon EventBridge.note: No managed event routing or serverless event bus service

AWS Step Functions.note: No managed workflow orchestration or state machine service

Amazon SES.note: No managed transactional or bulk email delivery service

Amazon Kinesis.note: No managed real-time data streaming service; stream processing must be self-hosted
